title: VMware Workstation VMXNET3 flaw (CVE-2026-59346, CVSS 9.3) lets attackers escape guest VMs to execute code on the host. Patch to 26H1u1 now.
content_md:
VMware Workstation VMXNET3 flaw (CVE-2026-59346, CVSS 9.3) lets attackers escape guest VMs to execute code on the host. Patch to 26H1u1 now.

via Mastodon https://deafnews.it/en/article/vmware-workstation-vmxnet3-bug-with-cvss-93-breaks-hypervisor-isolation
